title: Moesha
description:
S4 E11 — Barking Up The Wrong Tree
Hakeem accepts a job as assistant manager of the Class Act claiming there are financial difficulties at home. Moesha, concerned about his college education, confronts his mother who denies his claims.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E12 — Life Imitating Art
Racial tensions mount in Moesha’s high school after a mural depicting Latin American hero Caesar Chavez is purposely defaced.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E13 — OhMiGod, Fanatic
After Moesha and Kim have a huge fight, Moesha is surprised when MTV shows up at her door to film her bringing her best friend Kim to meet her favorite singer.  Leanne Rimes guest stars.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E14 — The Rite Stuff
Moesha wants to boycott her debutante ball when she learns one of the girls is thrown out of the ceremony because she is pregnant.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E15 — I Love Moesha
When Moesha is once again rejected from her friends’ band, we enter a black and white parody of I LOVE LUCY wherein Lucy (Moesha) tries to get into Ricky’s show.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E16 — Home Is Where The Car Is
Moesha is disappointed when she is not appointed valedictorian of her senior class.  She discovers the boy who has been appointed is homeless.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E17 — Girl’s Night In
At a slumber party, Moesha and her friends reminisce (with clips from past episodes) about the past four years together.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E18 — It Takes Two
Kim’s mother, Nikki, is re-entering a journey she started 18 years ago. With Dee’s help, she will be completing her education to receive a high school diploma.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E16 — Wedding Bell Blues
When Mark's demanding employer, P.J., tells him she is going to marry her old boyfriend and quit her job, Mark has to decide if he should tell her a secret that could make her cancel the wedding. Queen Latifah guest stars and sings "Just Another Day.".

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E17 — Truth or Consequences
Mark and Vanessa make a bet on who can go the longest without telling a lie.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E18 — Trading Places
When Vanessa applies for a job at a conservative Christian radio station, she tells the manager that Mark is her husband and Geneva is her wild cousin.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E19 — Pros and Convicts
When Vanessa shows Geneva how to have a good time, Geneva hits on a police officer who mistakes them both as prostitutes. They both are arrested, and Mark is arrested while trying to bail them out of jail.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E20 — Double Cheeseburger, Hold the Diploma
P.J. threatens to discharge Mark when his student, Earvin, quits school. Geneva can't afford to buy a new bicycle for her daughter, Nicole.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E21 — Groom and Doom
Mark introduces Geneva to a college teacher who asks her to marry him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E22 — Hangin' with Mrs. Cooper
Mark plots to reunite his parents after his mother, Dorothy (Ja'net DuBois), leaves her husband of 35 years and moves in with Mark. Richard Roundtree guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E1 — Call Me Irresponsible
Mark avoids P.J.'s phone calls and learns, too late, that she had good news. Geneva plays a trick on Vanessa to teach Nicole a lesson.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E16 — Family Affair
Still angry at Frank for keeping his true relationship to Dorian a secret for so long, Moesha decides not to introduce her father at an upcoming 'Businessman of the Year' awards banquet.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E17 — The Matchmaker
Hoping to boost the confidence of her new roommate, Theresa, Moesha asks Hakeem’s good-looking friend to ask Theresa on a date – but can’t leave well enough alone when the date is a success.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E18 — Gimme A Break
Moesha, Niecy, and Hakeem go to Santa Barbara for Spring Break. A campus rival spreads false information that Mo is 'easy' when her ex-boyfriend shows interest in Moesha.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E19 — Something About Moesha
Having been neighbors and friends nearly all their lives, Moesha and Hakeem wonder if there is more to their relationship.

description:

When sexual tension leads to conflict in the workplace between Spencer and Mona, Dee Dee and Adam encourage them to close the book on their romantic feelings for each other.

Mona and Dee attend a wedding of one of Dee's ex-boyfriends Neil, while Phyllis and Big Dee attend the funeral of someone they were both once intimately involved with.
